The '''Bravis Sith Lightsaber''' was a type of [[Lightsaber hilt/Legends|lightsaber hilt]] used by the [[Bravis Sith]]. It was often used with the [[Bravis Sith Lightsaber Crystal]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Bravis Sith Lightsaber first appeared in "[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'' (video game)]]" as a reward for lifetime Jedi members during the SOE's Super Fan Holidays event that took place during late November, 2010. It came with the Bravis Sith Lightsaber Crystal.
